mapper.update: UPDATE MARKETING_LEAD_INFO SET lead_status = #{targetStatus}, active_dedup_key = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED') THEN NULL ELSE active_dedup_key END, reviewed_by = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN #{updatedBy} ELSE reviewed_by END, reviewed_time = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN NOW() ELSE reviewed_time END, reject_reason = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'REJECTED' THEN #{rejectReason} WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'APPROVED' THEN NULL ELSE reject_reason END, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = NOW(), lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND lead_status = #{expectedStatus} AND record_status = 'ACTIVE'
